title: Evidence
description: One returned fragment, snapshotted at retrieval time with its score and provenance. Embedded inline inside EvidenceBundle — not independently stored, since a new retrieval always produces fresh Evidence.

procedure_id.description: ID of the underlying ProcedureRecord (denormalized here so grounding/generation don't need a lookup).

text.description: Snapshot of the fragment's text at retrieval time.

score.description: This fragment's relevance score from whichever method produced it.

method.description: Which retrieval path produced this piece of evidence (Section 8). 'exact_match' means the Section 8.1 shortcut fired.

source_id.description: ID of the SourceManifest this evidence traces back to.

source_version.description: Version label of the source at the time this evidence was retrieved, for audit.

effective_date.description: Effective date of the source this evidence came from.

source_locator.description: Pointer into the original source document, copied from ProcedureFragment.source_locator.
